t.zh: 一块电路可以写成几句等价，每根输出线对应它的输入：和位是「两个输入恰好一个是 1」，进位是「两个输入都是 1」。电路的性质，就是由这几句推得出的话。
t.en: A circuit can be written as equivalences, one per output wire against its inputs: the sum bit is “exactly one input is 1”, the carry bit “both inputs are 1”. A property of the circuit is whatever follows from them.

after.zh: 芯片设计里的形式验证，检查电路也是这个思路。
after.en: Formal verification in chip design checks circuits in this spirit.

brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手：推得出的目标证出来，推不出的报告失败。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves the goals that follow and reports failure on those that do not.
